Precautions Patients taking nevirapine should be closely monitored for adverse skin reactions and hepatotoxicity during the first 18 weeks of treatment; extra vigilance is ad- vised during the first 6 weeks of treatment. Nevirapine should be used with extreme caution in patients with moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh class B); it is contra-indicated in those with severe hepatic impair- ment (Child-Pugh class C).
